description: This file defines the class PduPart, which models a part of a multimedia message (MMS) PDU, including headers, data, and methods to manipulate them.

classes.name: PduPart
classes.description: Represents a part of an MMS PDU, containing headers, data, and associated methods for managing message parts.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets the part data as a byte array.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns a copy of the part data as a byte array.

methods.name: getDataLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the data, or 0 if no data is set.

methods.name: setDataUri
methods.description: Sets the URI for the part data.

methods.name: getDataUri
methods.description: Retrieves the URI for the part data.

methods.name: setContentId
methods.description: Sets the Content-ID header for the part.

methods.name: getContentId
methods.description: Gets the Content-ID header value.

methods.name: setCharset
methods.description: Sets the character set for the part.

methods.name: getCharset
methods.description: Retrieves the character set for the part.

methods.name: setContentLocation
methods.description: Sets the Content-Location header.

methods.name: getContentLocation
methods.description: Retrieves the Content-Location header.

methods.name: setContentDisposition
methods.description: Sets the Content-Disposition header.

methods.name: getContentDisposition
methods.description: Retrieves the Content-Disposition header.

methods.name: setContentType
methods.description: Sets the Content-Type header.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Retrieves the Content-Type header.

methods.name: setContentTransferEncoding
methods.description: Sets the Content-Transfer-Encoding header.

methods.name: getContentTransferEncoding
methods.description: Retrieves the Content-Transfer-Encoding header.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the 'name' parameter of the content, typically for Content-Type.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the 'name' parameter.

methods.name: setFilename
methods.description: Sets the filename parameter for the Content-Disposition.

methods.name: getFilename
methods.description: Retrieves the filename parameter.

methods.name: generateLocation
methods.description: Generates a location string for referencing the part, such as a URL or CID.
